thoughts.content: SQLite WAL mode lets the MCP server read while the app writes to the memory store.
Keep WAL mode on; a rollback journal blocked readers during long capture batches.
Backups copy the database with the SQLite online backup API after a WAL checkpoint.
Run a checkpoint before each nightly backup so the copied file is complete.
Schema migrations run inside one transaction and bump user_version last.
A failed migration rolls back and leaves the schema version untouched.
Vacuum the database monthly; deleted thoughts leave free pages behind.
Incremental vacuum reclaims pages without locking the store for long.
Full-text search uses FTS5 with the porter tokenizer and BM25 rank.
Prefix matching in the FTS query finds plurals like decisions and decision.
Hybrid search fuses keyword and vector results with reciprocal rank fusion.
Reciprocal rank fusion uses K of sixty so neither source dominates the merged ranking.
Callers supply embeddings; the server never runs an embedding model itself.
Embedding vectors are stored as float32 little-endian blobs beside each thought.
Vector search drops candidates below a cosine similarity threshold of 0.3.
Raising the similarity threshold hid paraphrases, so it stays at 0.3.
The HTTP transport uses OAuth with PKCE for remote clients.
OAuth tokens expire after an hour and refresh silently.
Local clients authenticate with a bearer token stored in the hook token file.
Rotate the bearer token whenever the hook token file is shared by mistake.
Provider credentials never reach the server; the Mac app keeps them in the Keychain.
Keychain items fall back to local storage when the access group entitlement is missing.
Read tools require the memory read scope; capture requires the write scope.
A token without the write scope gets an actionable error on capture.
The npm launcher downloads the native binary for the current platform.
Platform packages publish under optional dependencies so npm installs only one binary.
Release builds are signed and notarized before the DMG is published.
Notarization failures usually mean a nested binary lacks the hardened runtime.
The changelog Unreleased section becomes the release notes in the appcast.
Write changelog entries for users, not for reviewers.
Bump the short version and the build number together for every release.
The release tag comes from the short version string.
Projects are identified by immutable UUIDs, not by their slugs.
Renaming a project keeps its UUID and records the old slug as an alias.
Aliases let old project identifiers resolve after a rename.
An alias that points at two projects is ambiguous and fails closed.
Project-scoped search never returns another project's private thoughts.
Shared thoughts appear in other projects only when include_shared is set.
Project detection reads the git remote before falling back to the folder name.
Detection prefers the git remote because folder names collide across machines.
Briefs stay inside the caller's token budget and drop low-priority items first.
The brief token estimate counts four characters per token.
Untrusted memory text is fenced in briefs so it cannot issue instructions.
External captures default to the untrusted trust level until confirmed.
Superseded decisions are excluded from briefs once consolidated.
Briefs prefer the newest confirmed decision over a stale duplicate.
A brief opens with active decisions, then recent work, then references.
Brief sections are omitted when they have no items.
The other project also runs a checkpoint before its backup job.
Rank fusion in the other project weights keyword results higher.
The other project stores its bearer token in an environment variable.
The other project never uses an alias for its repository.
The other project tuned its similarity threshold down to 0.2.
The other project fences untrusted web content in its prompts.
